operating_systems: Windows 10/11 or Windows Server with NTFS
core.secure_filesystem_helpers: portable_fs.py uses descriptor-relative no-follow operations on POSIX and rejects Windows symlinks, junctions, and reparse-point ancestors with identity-bound reads and exclusive writes

optional.native_word_rendering: Microsoft Word for Windows through PowerShell COM automation or Microsoft Word for macOS with AppleScript authorization
optional.native_powerpoint_rendering: Microsoft PowerPoint for Windows through PowerShell COM automation or Microsoft PowerPoint for macOS with AppleScript authorization
optional.powerpoint_generation: Node.js ES modules and host-provided @oai/artifact-tool bound by create_artifact_runtime_receipt.mjs
optional.pdf_page_rendering: host document/PDF capability or an explicitly trusted, version-bound renderer
